/* ===== YOLO LAB 響應式優化 (手機/平板/電腦) ===== */
/* 1) 全域：避免任何橫向溢出，圖片自適應 */
html, body { overflow-x: hidden; max-width: 100%; }
img, video, iframe { max-width: 100%; height: auto; }

/* ===== 平板與手機 (≤ 781px)：欄位堆疊成單欄 ===== */
@media (max-width: 781px) {
  /* 讓所有欄位區塊改為直向堆疊，主內容在上、側欄在下 */
  .wp-block-columns.is-layout-flex,
  .wp-block-columns {
    flex-wrap: wrap !important;
    flex-direction: column !important;
    gap: 1.5rem !important;
  }
  .wp-block-columns > .wp-block-column,
  .wp-block-column {
    flex-basis: 100% !important;
    max-width: 100% !important;
    width: 100% !important;
  }

  /* 群組類橫向排版在窄螢幕也換行，避免擠壓 */
  .wp-block-group.is-nowrap.is-layout-flex {
    flex-wrap: wrap !important;
  }

  /* 主標題字級縮放，避免破版 */
  h1, .wp-block-post-title { font-size: clamp(1.6rem, 7vw, 2.2rem) !important; line-height: 1.25 !important; }
  h2 { font-size: clamp(1.3rem, 5.5vw, 1.8rem) !important; line-height: 1.3 !important; }
  h3 { font-size: clamp(1.15rem, 5vw, 1.5rem) !important; line-height: 1.35 !important; }

  /* 內文最小可讀字級 */
  p, li, .wp-block-post-excerpt { font-size: 1rem !important; line-height: 1.7 !important; }

  /* 內容左右留白，避免貼邊 */
  .wp-block-post-content, .entry-content { padding-left: 4vw !important; padding-right: 4vw !important; }
}

/* ===== 手機 (≤ 600px)：更精緻的調整 ===== */
@media (max-width: 600px) {
  /* 導覽列換行並加大可點擊間距 */
  .wp-block-navigation.is-layout-flex {
    flex-wrap: wrap !important;
    gap: 0.5rem 1rem !important;
    justify-content: center !important;
  }
  .wp-block-navigation-item__content { padding: 0.4em 0.2em !important; }

  /* 訂閱按鈕不要佔滿造成擠壓 */
  .wp-block-button__link { white-space: nowrap; }

  /* 表單輸入框與按鈕在窄螢幕堆疊 */
  .wp-block-group.is-nowrap { flex-wrap: wrap !important; }
}

/* ===== 桌面微調 (≥ 1024px)：側欄與內容間距更舒適 ===== */
@media (min-width: 1024px) {
  .wp-block-columns { gap: 2.5rem !important; }
}

/* ===== 頁尾微調：避免浮動訂閱按鈕遮住頁尾內容 ===== */
@media (max-width: 781px) {
  /* 頁尾預留底部空間，讓浮動訂閱鈕不壓到內容 */
  footer.wp-block-template-part,
  .wp-block-template-part:last-of-type {
    padding-bottom: 90px !important;
  }

  /* 頁尾橫向排版改為換行並置中，避免文字擠在一起 */
  footer .wp-block-group.is-nowrap,
  footer .wp-block-columns {
    flex-wrap: wrap !important;
    flex-direction: column !important;
    text-align: center !important;
    gap: 0.75rem !important;
  }
  footer .wp-block-column { text-align: center !important; }

  /* 浮動訂閱按鈕稍微內縮，視覺更精緻 */
  .jetpack-subscribe-floating-button { right: 8px !important; bottom: 8px !important; }
}

/* ===== UI/UX 與效能優化 (PageSpeed 建議) ===== */
/* 觸控目標優化：手機上可點擊元素加大，符合 Google 行動友善 (最小 44x44px) */
@media (max-width: 781px) {
  /* 分類標籤、選單、頁腳連結等小連結加大點擊區 */
  .wp-block-navigation-item__content,
  .wp-block-categories a,
  .wp-block-tag-cloud a,
  .widget a,
  footer a {
    display: inline-block;
    min-height: 44px;
    line-height: 44px;
    padding: 0 6px;
  }
  /* 文章列表的『閱讀全文』等連結加大 */
  .wp-block-read-more, .more-link {
    display: inline-block;
    min-height: 44px;
    line-height: 44px;
    padding: 0 14px;
  }
  /* 相鄰小連結之間留出間距，避免誤觸 */
  .wp-block-categories li, .wp-block-tag-cloud { margin-bottom: 4px; }
}

/* 圖片解碼提示與防止版面位移 (降低 CLS) */
img { content-visibility: auto; }
img:not([width]):not([height]) { aspect-ratio: 16 / 9; }

/* 連結可辨識性 (UX)：確保連結有清楚的互動回饋 */
a { transition: opacity .15s ease; }
a:hover { opacity: .85; }

/* 焦點可見性 (無障礙/鍵盤導覽) */
a:focus-visible, button:focus-visible, input:focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid currentColor;
  outline-offset: 2px;
}

/* ========================================================= */
/* ===== 閱讀體驗強化 (Reading Experience & SEO) ===== */
/* ========================================================= */

/* 1) 內文字型：大段中文內文改用高可讀性無襯線字型，標題保留品牌等寬風格 */
.wp-block-post-content p,
.entry-content p,
.wp-block-post-content li,
.entry-content li {
  font-family: 'Noto Sans TC', 'PingFang TC', 'Microsoft JhengHei', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif !important;
  font-size: 1.075rem !important;
  line-height: 1.9 !important;        /* 放寬行高，中文長文更好讀 */
  letter-spacing: 0.02em !important;  /* 微調字距提升辨識度 */
}

/* 2) 段落間距：原本段落間距為 0，黏成一團，補上呼吸空間 */
.wp-block-post-content p,
.entry-content p {
  margin-top: 0 !important;
  margin-bottom: 1.35em !important;
}

/* 3) 最佳閱讀行長：限制內文段落寬度 (約 70 中文字/行)，避免一行太長 */
.wp-block-post-content > p,
.entry-content > p,
.wp-block-post-content > ul,
.wp-block-post-content > ol {
  max-width: 42em;
}

/* 4) 內文連結清楚可見：原本半透明灰幾乎看不到 */
.wp-block-post-content a,
.entry-content a {
  color: #6db3f2 !important;
  text-decoration: underline !important;
  text-underline-offset: 3px;
  text-decoration-thickness: 1px;
}
.wp-block-post-content a:hover,
.entry-content a:hover { color: #9ccdf7 !important; }

/* 5) 標題節奏：拉開段落與標題的視覺層次，方便掃讀與 Google 解析結構 */
.wp-block-post-content h2, .entry-content h2 {
  margin-top: 2.2em !important;
  margin-bottom: 0.8em !important;
  line-height: 1.4 !important;
  padding-bottom: 0.3em;
  border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.12);
}
.wp-block-post-content h3, .entry-content h3 {
  margin-top: 1.8em !important;
  margin-bottom: 0.6em !important;
  line-height: 1.45 !important;
}

/* 6) 清單可讀性 */
.wp-block-post-content li, .entry-content li { margin-bottom: 0.5em !important; }

/* 7) 引言區塊更醒目 (提升閱讀層次) */
.wp-block-post-content blockquote, .entry-content blockquote {
  border-left: 4px solid #6db3f2;
  padding: 0.6em 1.2em;
  margin: 1.6em 0;
  background: rgba(109,179,242,0.06);
  font-style: normal;
}

/* 8) 內文圖片圓角與間距，視覺更精緻 */
.wp-block-post-content img, .entry-content img {
  border-radius: 8px;
  margin: 1.2em 0;
}

/* 9) 手機閱讀微調：字級與左右留白 */
@media (max-width: 781px) {
  .wp-block-post-content p, .entry-content p,
  .wp-block-post-content li, .entry-content li {
    font-size: 1.05rem !important;
    line-height: 1.85 !important;
  }
}

<h2 class="wp-block-heading" id="faq"><span id="2026-2">2026 亞運觀賽常見問題</span></h2>



<h3 class="wp-block-heading"><span id="i-6">中華隊最新獎牌數，要看哪一張表？</span></h3>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">看本頁上方列出查核時間的官方累計數，或直接點官方獎牌榜。總榜和單場結果可能不是同一時間更新，團體賽也不能按隊員人數自行加總獎牌。</p>



<h3 class="wp-block-heading"><span id="i-7">已經晉級或至少保銅，可以當成正式獎牌嗎？</span></h3>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">應先保留「晉級」或「至少保銅」的說法，待大會正式結果、最終名次或獎牌名單確認後，再寫入正式得牌紀錄。排名賽贏一場也不等於取得該區間最高名次。</p>



<h3 class="wp-block-heading"><span id="-1400-1400">「不早於 14:00」是不是 14:00 一定開打？</span></h3>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">不是。這是最早可能開始的時間，仍取決於前場進度與休息安排。先確認標示的是台灣或日本時間，再點進官方場次查狀態。</p>



<h3 class="wp-block-heading"><span id="43-43">43 種運動，為什麼本頁沒有 43 個專頁？</span></h3>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">43 是大會運動種類數；單項專頁依本站已發布的中華隊內容整理。某些大項會再拆成不同科目，例如網球與軟式網球；未有專頁的比賽仍可從官方每日賽程查詢。</p>



<h3 class="wp-block-heading"><span id="i-8">有直播方案，為什麼仍看不到指定選手？</span></h3>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">先檢查是不是同一日期與輪次、是否播重播，以及該場是否位於有公用訊號的場地。即使平台有亞運轉播，也不表示每位選手、每一輪都有直播；訊號限制和平台公告見上方直播段落。</p>



<h3 class="wp-block-heading"><span id="i-9">比賽結束後，哪裡找完整結果和回放？</span></h3>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">成績以官方單項的 Final Rank、Medals 與 Reports 回查；影音則在原收視平台找賽事影音或回看。回放是否完整、保留多久、是否需原方案，都要看該平台標示。</p>



<h2 class="wp-block-heading" id="archive"><span id="i-10">賽後回查：獎牌得主、最終名次與歷史戰況</span></h2>

(function round9SelfServiceInstrumentationPreview() {
  "use strict";

  const EVENT_VERSION = "round9-v1";
  const GUIDE_PATH = "/ai-tools-no-credit-card";
  const root = document.documentElement;
  const officialTools = new Map([
    ["chatgpt.com", "chatgpt"],
    ["claude.com", "claude"],
    ["gemini.google.com", "gemini"],
    ["copilot.microsoft.com", "copilot"],
    ["perplexity.ai", "perplexity"],
    ["chat.mistral.ai", "mistral"],
    ["aistudio.google.com", "google_ai_studio"],
    ["ollama.com", "ollama"],
    ["lmstudio.ai", "lm_studio"]
  ]);
  const nextSteps = new Map([
    ["/ai-agent", "ai_agent"],
    ["/ai-readiness-check", "readiness"],
    ["/solutions/ai-workflow-audit", "workflow_audit"],
    ["/consultation", "consultation"]
  ]);

  function pagePath() {
    return new URL(window.location.href).pathname.replace(/\/$/, "") || "/";
  }

  function safeAttribution(url) {
    const source = url.searchParams.get("source");
    const placement = url.searchParams.get("placement");
    return {
      ...(source && /^(?:home|readiness|self_service_guide)$/.test(source) ? { source } : {}),
      ...(placement && /^guide_[a-z0-9_]+$/.test(placement) ? { placement } : {})
    };
  }

  function emit(name, params) {
    const eventParams = { event_version: EVENT_VERSION, ...params };
    const marker = `data-yolo-round9-event-${name.replace(/_/g, "-")}`;
    const previousCount = Number(root.getAttribute(marker) || "0");
    root.setAttribute(marker, String(previousCount + 1));
    window.__yoloRound9Events = window.__yoloRound9Events || [];
    window.__yoloRound9Events.push({ name, params: eventParams });
    window.dataLayer = window.dataLayer || [];
    window.gtag = window.gtag || ((...args) => window.dataLayer.push(args));
    window.gtag("event", name, eventParams);
  }

  function toolFor(url) {
    return officialTools.get(url.hostname.toLowerCase().replace(/^www\./, "")) || null;
  }

  function bindGuide() {
    if (pagePath() !== GUIDE_PATH || root.dataset.yoloRound9GuideBound === "1") return;
    root.dataset.yoloRound9GuideBound = "1";
    const guide = document.querySelector("main") || document.body;
    const toolLinks = Array.from(guide.querySelectorAll("a[href]"))
      .filter((link) => toolFor(new URL(link.href, window.location.href)) !== null);
    const toolPositions = new WeakMap(toolLinks.map((link, index) => [link, `guide_tool_${index + 1}`]));

    if (root.dataset.yoloRound9GuideViewed !== "1") {
      root.dataset.yoloRound9GuideViewed = "1";
      emit("self_service_guide_view", {
        content_cluster: "ai_agent_beginner",
        funnel_stage: "tofu",
        page_path: GUIDE_PATH
      });
    }

    document.addEventListener("click", (event) => {
      const target = event.target instanceof Element ? event.target.closest("a[href]") : null;
      if (!target || !guide.contains(target)) return;
      const url = new URL(target.href, window.location.href);
      const tool = toolFor(url);
      if (tool) {
        emit("self_service_tool_click", {
          content_cluster: "ai_agent_beginner",
          funnel_stage: "tofu",
          page_path: GUIDE_PATH,
          tool,
          link_position: toolPositions.get(target) || "guide_tool_unknown"
        });
        return;
      }
      const destination = nextSteps.get(url.pathname.replace(/\/$/, ""));
      if (!destination) return;
      emit("self_service_next_step_click", {
        content_cluster: "ai_agent_beginner",
        funnel_stage: "mofu",
        page_path: GUIDE_PATH,
        destination,
        ...safeAttribution(url)
      });
    }, true);
  }

  function bindConsultationSuccess() {
    if (pagePath() !== "/consultation" || root.dataset.yoloRound9FormBound === "1") return;
    const formRoot = document.querySelector(".yolo-consultation-form");
    const successNode = formRoot?.querySelector(".contact-form-submission.contact-form-ajax-submission");
    if (!formRoot || !successNode) return;
    root.dataset.yoloRound9FormBound = "1";
    let wasSuccessful = successNode.classList.contains("submission-success");
    const observer = new MutationObserver(() => {
      const isSuccessful = successNode.classList.contains("submission-success");
      if (isSuccessful && !wasSuccessful) {
        emit("fit_form_submit", {
          content_cluster: "ai_workflow_audit",
          funnel_stage: "bofu",
          form_name: "ai_workflow_fit",
          conversion_status: "success",
          page_path: "/consultation",
          ...safeAttribution(new URL(window.location.href))
        });
      }
      wasSuccessful = isSuccessful;
    });
    observer.observe(formRoot, { attributes: true, attributeFilter: ["class"], subtree: true });
  }

  function init() {
    bindGuide();
    bindConsultationSuccess();
  }

  if (document.readyState === "loading") document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", init, { once: true });
  else init();
})();
